examples.title: defaultTextStyle15+
examples.description:
defaultTextStyle(style: TextPickerTextStyle)
Sets the text style of the items when the text style change animation during scrolling is disabled. This setting takes effect only when disableTextStyleAnimation is set to true.
Atomic service API: This API can be used in atomic services since API version 15.
System capability: SystemCapability.ArkUI.ArkUI.Full
Parameters
Text style of the items when the text style change animation during scrolling is disabled.
Default value: same as the default value of the Text component
To enable haptic feedback, you must declare the following permission under requestPermissions in module in src/main/module.json5 of the project.

examples.title: enableHapticFeedback18+
examples.description:
enableHapticFeedback(enable: Optional<boolean>)
Sets whether to enable haptic feedback.
Atomic service API: This API can be used in atomic services since API version 18.
System capability: SystemCapability.ArkUI.ArkUI.Full
Parameters
Whether to enable haptic feedback.
- true: Enable haptic feedback.
- false: Disable haptic feedback.
Default value: true
Whether this parameter takes effect after being set to true depends on hardware support.
To enable haptic feedback, you must declare the following permission under requestPermissions in module in src/main/module.json5 of the project.

examples.title: Example 1: Setting the Number of Columns in the Picker
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to configure single-column and multi-column text pickers by setting range and customizing the width of each column using columnWidths.
The columnWidths attribute of TextPickerOptions is added since API version 18.

examples.title: Example 2: Setting the Text Style
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to configure disappearTextStyle, textStyle, and selectedTextStyle to customize the text style in the text picker.

examples.title: Example 3: Using the No-Divider Style
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to configure a text picker with no divider by setting divider to null.

examples.title: Example 4: Using the Divider Style
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the divider style for the text picker by configuring DividerOptions for divider.

examples.title: Example 5: Setting the Fade Effect
examples.description: This example shows how to set the gradient effect height for the text picker by configuring gradientHeight.

examples.title: Example 6: Setting the Item Height
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the height of the picker items by configuring defaultPickerItemHeight.

examples.title: Example 7: Setting Loop Scrolling
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set whether to enable loop scrolling using canLoop.

examples.title: Example 8: Setting the Selected Item Index
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the index of the default selected item by configuring selectedIndex.

examples.title: Example 9: Disabling the Text Style Animation and Setting the Corresponding Text Style
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to disable the text style change animation for the text picker and set the text style by configuring disableTextStyleAnimation and defaultTextStyle.
The disableTextStyleAnimation and defaultTextStyle APIs are supported since API version 15.

examples.title: Example 10: Setting the Background Style of the Selected Item
examples.description: This example shows how to set the background style of the selected item by configuring selectedBackgroundStyle.

examples.title: Example 11: Setting the Font Size Range and Text Overflow Mode
examples.description:
This example shows how to set the text color, maximum font size, minimum font size, and text overflow mode by configuring disappearTextStyle, textStyle, and selectedTextStyle.
The disappearTextStyle, textStyle, and selectedTextStyle APIs are supported since API version 20.
